summary: The v3 suite replaces the dashboard-style v1 figures with six data-first main figures, four Extended Data figures and source-data exports. It is a coherent manuscript-draft visual system, but it is not submission approved because independent biological validation and closed third-party numerical benchmarks remain absent.

strengths: Direct frozen-H5AD composition and dataset provenance.
Data contract and evaluation atlas are visible without an architecture-only dashboard.
Panel-level TSV source data is exported.
remaining_repairs: Add directly measured ortholog-retention data when a wider corpus is frozen.

strengths: Uses v17 nested selection as the strict primary result.
Shows per-species heterogeneity, cell bootstrap and open-set coverage directly.
Keeps v14 global selection visibly exploratory.
remaining_repairs: Add independent-collection and group-resampling uncertainty before final submission.

strengths: Numerical comparisons are restricted to frozen matched v3-v9 protocols.
External comparison status is explicitly presented as an audit, not as a performance ranking.
remaining_repairs: Replace pending audit rows with reproducible official third-party outputs.

strengths: Shows support/query nonoverlap and ten-draw uncertainty.
Makes support-budget and species-dependence interpretable in one figure.
remaining_repairs: Add an independent target-species collection and matched baseline.

strengths: Dense biological identity and marker-candidate evidence.
Distinguishes computational candidates from wet-lab validation.
remaining_repairs: Add independent query-cell replication or experimental validation.

strengths: Shows calibration/selectivity and runtime species heterogeneity.
Clearly isolates full-vocabulary deployment from strict zero-shot evaluation.
remaining_repairs: Validate runtime calibration on an independent deployment collection.

unmet_package_requirements: Independent public biological/query-cell replication is absent.
scPlantLLM and scPlantAnnotate official numeric outputs are not closed.
A final-size journal-template review and public immutable release remain required.
The figure suite must not be called a Nature Methods-level proof of universal plant annotation.
approval_rule: Set status to approved only after a clean-environment rerun, immutable public release, independent data validation, journal-template inspection and closure of every numerical comparison displayed as a head-to-head result.
